decision: Adopt the already verified public retrieval operation; keep exact requested source availability and version as explicit unconfirmed external input obligations.
component_scope: The public_source_access catalog is reused with its existing transport limits; no exact IRS or AbbVie URL response or edition is established by this review.

prompt_clause.text: The 1040 should be provided in PDF form, and should include any Schedules or Forms that would be required to be e-filed with the Form 1040 according to current IRS regulations for the 2024 tax year.

criterion_evidence.original_description: Provides a PDF of IRS Form 1040 (tax year 2024) containing pages 1 and 2 for Robert (Bob) and Lisa Smith
Provides a compiled PDF that includes all IRS forms and schedules required to be e-filed with the Form 1040 based on the provided 2024 documents
All included IRS forms and schedules in the deliverable are for tax year 2024

source_input_obligations.requirement: Identify and obtain the official IRS Form 1040 and required schedules/forms for tax year 2024, retaining source and edition evidence; actual filing is not requested.
source_input_obligations.remaining_obligation: Exact required tax-year-2024 form and schedule availability, edition and completeness are unconfirmed. Participant retrieval and comparison with the original requirements remain necessary; do not substitute another tax year.

criterion_evidence.original_description: All typed entries on the application are digitally entered (no fabricated handwriting or images to simulate signatures/initials).
All pages of the completed application are present in the PDF, in order, and typed entries render legibly when opened.
Any fields on the application for which no data are provided in the chart or insurance card are intentionally left blank or marked as not available (no invented data).
No fabricated signatures: patient and prescriber signature/date fields are left blank unless signatures/dates are provided in the references.

source_input_obligations.requirement: Obtain the AbbVie Vraylar patient assistance application from the exact URL named in the prompt and retain the returned body/source/version evidence; actual submission is not requested.
source_input_obligations.remaining_obligation: Availability and version of the PDF at the exact prompt URL are unconfirmed.
